summary: Firefox’s layout engine received a broad set of fixes and improvements, especially for CSS `line-clamp` (limiting text to a set number of lines), grid and flex sizing, and positioned content. The changes also improve interactions with view transitions and selection, let user CSS override native control styling, and add support for the proposed `loading` attribute on `<video>` and `<audio>` elements, which can defer loading media. Several other updates address text rendering, scrolling, and accessibility, alongside internal maintenance.
